name: vuka-server
description: Vuka Uzenzele API — Express + built-in SQLite + JWT auth.
comment:overrides: qs <=6.15.3 carries two DoS advisories (GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g, GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx) and reaches us through express -> body-parser, where it parses attacker-controlled query strings on a public API. Express 4.22.2 is the newest 4.x and still pins a vulnerable qs, so the only fix without a major upgrade is to force the patched minor here. Same major, API-compatible. Remove this once express ships a 4.x that depends on qs >= 6.16.
